entries.what: Labor Day off from the cafe. Jun sleeps in, then helps Tess roll a test batch of lumpia in the kitchen of her house off Vinca Avenue while she complains about her left knee.
entries.outcome: Two trays rolled and frozen for the weekend.

entries.what: Stops by the Delgado Park holiday picnic crowd to hand out a few lumpia samples to cousins, then meets Paolo to plan Saturday prep; Paolo admits he has already missed two early prep sessions this fall.
entries.outcome: Agreed on a Friday night prep plan, Jun quietly expects to do most of it.

entries.what: Evening at home sketching a price sign and counting leftover wrapper cases in the garage.
entries.outcome: Decided $10 a half dozen feels right.

entries.what: Opening shift at Heron & Grind from 6:15; Wes shows up for his 7 a.m. cortado and chats about machinist days.
entries.outcome: Smooth morning rush, Jun teaches Linh a quick milk-steaming fix.

entries.what: Talks to Beatrice in the back office, with her corgi Ledger underfoot, about selling lumpia at the counter on Saturdays.
entries.outcome: She agrees to a Saturday table for a 15% cut starting this week.

entries.what: After work buys wrappers and shrimp at Ruiz Family Market and eats a late lunch at his mom's house.
entries.outcome: Receipts go into the shoebox again.

entries.what: Opens the cafe, then on his break finishes renewing his food handler card online.
entries.outcome: Card renewed, valid until 2027.

entries.what: Afternoon practicing the shaping of lumpia at home with his Bluetooth speaker playing old OPM ballads.
entries.outcome: About 60 rolled, speed improving.

entries.what: Tess is off on Wednesdays, so she tastes a trial batch and picks at the filling.
entries.outcome: She says nothing yet, which makes him nervous.

entries.what: Before an early shift, Jun opens the cottage food permit form and asks the assistant which box to check, admitting it has sat open in a tab for two weeks.
entries.outcome: Gets the box answers but still has not filed.

entries.what: Works the opening shift at Heron & Grind, chatting up regulars about Saturday's lumpia.
entries.outcome: Linh offers to look over his cost numbers later.

entries.what: Evening wrapping and prepping filling with Tess for the weekend.
entries.outcome: Filling mixed, 150 target looks doable.

entries.what: Opening shift at the cafe; Egrets football opener tonight so half the staff talks about the game.
entries.outcome: Sam texts about swapping a Saturday shift; Jun says no since he'll be at the table.

entries.what: Friday prep night at Tess's kitchen rolling lumpia; Paolo shows up late from his closing shift schedule worries, so Jun does most of it.
entries.outcome: About 150 rolled and frozen by midnight.

entries.what: Hears the stadium crowd noise from the Egrets opener drifting over the neighborhood while he cleans up.
entries.outcome: Goes to bed late.

entries.what: First Saturday lumpia sales at the end of the Heron & Grind counter, $10 for a half dozen, about 150 lumpia prepared.
entries.outcome: Sells out by early afternoon.

entries.what: Wes buys two lumpia and pays in quarters, starting a habit.
entries.outcome: Wes promises to be back next Saturday.

entries.what: Counts cash at the counter and drops the receipts into the shoebox.
entries.outcome: Cash totals scribbled in his notes app.

entries.what: Tess calls the batch 'too much onion' even though it sold out, so Jun rewrites the filling ratio at her kitchen table.
entries.outcome: New ratio with less onion written on the fridge list.

entries.what: Sunday pickup basketball at Delgado Park in the morning.
entries.outcome: Loses two games, shakes off the week.

entries.what: Evening tallying the week's costs and planning next Saturday's batch.
entries.outcome: Plans a slightly bigger batch.
